cost_output_contract.material_count_rule: Each policy is one material configuration whose organizer run emits base and doubled-cost outputs together. The two cost panels are not separately selected and do not count as two policy trials.

policies.hypothesis: Execution/control baseline with no enabled optional risk control.
Scale gross exposure from trailing realized portfolio volatility without exceeding the strategy request.
Progressively reduce gross after authoritative portfolio drawdowns of 12%, 20%, and 28%.
Close a symbol only after a 12% position loss is confirmed and block same-boundary reentry with a three-bar cooldown.
Cap one-way turnover at 40% per boundary to test whether signal churn is a failure mode after ordinary capacity and costs.
Combine volatility targeting, drawdown brakes, position stop, and turnover limit without side scaling or time stop.

registration_rule: All six policies are prospective and must be separately preregistered before results. Compare return, Sharpe, drawdown, tail loss, turnover, regimes, action counts, cooldown, requested/filled risk notional, and reentry prevention. Controls cannot qualify a strategy that fails any development gate.
